Eight synthetic checks passed, covering interruption after remote acceptance, concurrent controllers, lost observations, input/receipt tampering, partial publication and preservation of negative outcomes. Two separate controller invocations verified the real twelve-file candidate archive and resumed to adopt the existing submission. No new control job or model call was made. This is not yet an end-to-end unattended demonstration: terminal collection/readback are wired, while HF publication and cleanup adapters remain pending. The controller advances only on verified evidence and does not equate a completed job with a positive control pair.

All twelve candidate files remained unchanged. Both verifier stdout logs show successful editable rebuilds using the local dependency cache. [Results and limitation](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/353c661d/experiments/34-offline-rebuild/control-diagnosis.md).

The dependency-version/hash receipt was not retained: the supervisor found no remaining control image, and archived build logs do not contain the executed receipt. This is positive runtime evidence, not complete dependency provenance. The original missing-receipt result remains explicit; no task repair or automatic rerun was performed.

The resume controller collected and verified the existing result, then published 16 reviewed objects with complete anonymous readback: [HF receipt](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/5d77121f/experiments/33-unattended-validation/offline-evidence-receipt.json). Allocated CPU usage is 2.203877 hours before cleanup; no model calls or new capacity. One ownership-gated cleanup job was submitted with a 1/6 CPU-hour reservation. Full reproducibility and final cleanup verification remain pending; both issues stay open.

🤖 Owned-image cleanup is now verified from its hash-checked output archive: no owned images/containers remain. Total allocation is 2.211349 CPU-hours, with no outstanding CPU reservation and no model calls. [Cleanup receipt](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/f008061c/experiments/34-offline-rebuild/macs-742-image-cleanup-readback-001.json).

[The resumed lifecycle](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/41c430b3/experiments/33-unattended-validation/resume-demonstration.json) reached all eight recorded stages and repeated invocation produces no new effect. This adopted an existing control submission; unattended initial submission is not yet demonstrated. Exact dependency receipt capture remains unresolved, and the small cleanup archive is retained locally pending HF preservation. No further run has been launched. The epic remains incomplete and open.

🤖 The remaining cleanup archive is now preserved in a separate six-object HF snapshot with anonymous readback: [receipt](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/67778568/experiments/33-unattended-validation/offline-cleanup-evidence-receipt.json). All first-comparison execution archives are preserved; no active job or retained remote image remains.

Prepared a separate evidence-only instrumentation candidate that captures the dependency receipt immediately after image build, using a stopped networkless container. Five synthetic failure/ownership checks pass. The original wrapper and original missing-receipt result are unchanged. [Protocol and limitations](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/e3c728d2/experiments/34-offline-rebuild/receipt-capture-protocol.md).

Next is a checkpointed unattended comparison that preserves exact dependency receipts and covers initial submission, rather than only adopting an existing run. Because the old reconstruction was cleaned, any repeat is a distinct reconstructed environment. An eight-CPU-hour worst-case bound would fit the existing twelve-hour child allowance, but no new reservation or run has been made. Model execution remains disabled.

🤖 Prepared the combined no-model confirmation job: frozen reconstruction → actual-image-bound candidate packaging → original nop/oracle controls with receipt capture before teardown. [Checkpoint](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/tree/62ea8ecb/experiments/34-offline-rebuild).

The local real-input packaging check verified all ten original files, twelve candidate files, nine unchanged non-Dockerfile assets and overwrite refusal; its image digest was synthetic, so this is not a Docker result. Twenty-five payload files are hash-bound. The single-attempt submitter and terminal/cleanup helpers are prepared. No new reservation, preflight or remote submission has occurred. Complete readback, archival and outer lifecycle wiring before admission; preserve the first comparison unchanged.

🤖 The unattended controller is now active on the fixed handle `/exedev/biotasks34-macs-742-confirm-001`, submitted from checkpoint `c2b401d3`; its first observation was pending at 23:12:40 UTC. [Submission](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/06c0fe7825fa86301531017827b9503ec27a3aab/experiments/34-offline-rebuild/confirmation-submission.json). It advances reconstruction → actual-image-bound packaging → original controls → receipt verification → reviewed HF snapshot/readback → owned cleanup, without task repairs or model calls. Nine interruption/transition checks pass. The controller observes every five minutes and never retries an uncertain submission under a new handle.

Reserved eight CPU-hours plus 1/6 hour for cleanup; worst-case child allocation including prior work is 10.378016 hours against the twelve-hour ceiling. No new capacity or paid model calls. The first comparison remains preserved and cleaned. The MACS diagnostic is separate from the frozen 83-export cohort, whose counts remain unchanged.

🤖 Performed a real controller restart while the remote confirmation remained active. Session40839 exited130 during its scheduled sleep; session6070 resumed the same command with identical journal and submission hashes. At 23:23:22 UTC the resumed controller authoritatively observed the same handle running. No submission stage was re-entered. [Restart proof](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/ac64210251762c97cad547e3d406526d3e1ac22c/experiments/33-unattended-validation/confirmation-restart-proof.json).

The final attempt count, scientific outcome, dependency receipts, HF readback and cleanup remain pending. Independently rehashed all five protected raw archives: every size/hash matches retention records; no restricted bytes were uploaded and known disposable fixture paths are clear.

🤖 Added an evidence-only final acceptance check: both control receipts must contain identical wheel filename/version/hash/size sets and identical Python/platform, in addition to positive controls, clean oracle command, unchanged candidate files and verified lifecycle receipts. Equal requirement ranges alone are insufficient. [Summarizer](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/533dfc19/experiments/33-unattended-validation/summarize_confirmation.py). Synthetic checks reject missing receipts, changed wheel bytes and changed interpreter evidence; task execution and grading are unchanged.

The existing fixed confirmation handle was authoritatively running at 23:28:23 UTC. The same resumed controller remains active; no new run or model call was made. Scientific acceptance remains pending actual output.

🤖 Verified eight upstream source files against the pinned acquisition manifest and Git blob identities. Native bootstrap registry support and push-time registry/inline export are already implemented. [Exact source bindings](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/2aeb8342/experiments/35-durable-runtime-artifacts/source-assessment.json).

A source-level edge case needs a retrieval gate: bootstrap may record a successful push even if resolving RepoDigests yields no pullable reference. This is not a reproduced registry failure. Native `--skip-image-push` also assumes remote availability. Require an actual qualified reference and fresh-worker controls. Explicit inline mode requires a cached bootstrap recipe; recipe compatibility and reconstruction behavior remain unverified.

No source package was executed, credentials inspected, task transformed, remote job launched or image uploaded. The sole active remote run remains #34’s existing confirmation, last observed running at 23:38:27 UTC.

🤖 The unattended confirmation is complete and passes all nine scientific/provenance gates: native reconstruction, unchanged candidate, image binding, two receipts tied to their control builds, identical dependency sets, nop 0/oracle 1, clean oracle command and all ten regressions preserved. Direct pytest logs independently show nop 1 failed/10 passed/1 skipped and oracle 11 passed/1 skipped. [Audited result](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/8628f2c9/experiments/33-unattended-validation/confirmation-summary.json).

The real controller restart retained the same remote handle, terminal accounting records one run attempt and one cleanup attempt, and completed reinvocation leaves the journal unchanged. Ten main-snapshot objects and eleven final cleanup/summary objects passed anonymous HF readback. [Final receipt](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/9d073a5a/experiments/33-unattended-validation/confirmation-final-evidence-receipt.json). No owned remote resources or active controller remain; transfer caches/readbacks are removed. Bounded offline audit staging is 366,872 bytes with exact retention conditions recorded; no `/tmp` evidence remains.

Total additional allocation is 4.429718 CPU-hours, with no outstanding CPU reservation, new capacity or model call. Recorded paid cost remains $0 with $10 storage reservation pending reconciliation. The same-worker lifecycle is established for this one diagnostic. #35 remains open to verify a runnable artifact on another clean worker using upstream’s existing distribution routes. All child issues remain open for review.

[Separate attempt ledger and reconciled budget](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/tree/52e96612/experiments/33-unattended-validation) and [complete task table/raw receipts](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/tree/fc8f900f/experiments/38-manifest-validation).
